summary: Iteration 2 focused on the 4 reported visual bugs (overline CSS collision, About H2 typography, 'SOBRE MÍ' eyebrow prominence, global text overlap) plus backend/form regression. Backend pytest suite: 8/8 passed. Frontend verified via computed-style DOM audits on desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844. ALL 4 bugs verified FIXED. 25 .eyebrow elements have textDecorationLine='none'; zero elements anywhere on the page have overline/line-through; document.querySelectorAll('.overline').length === 0 on both viewports. about-title reads exactly 'Rigor legal, agilidad operativa.' fully in Cormorant Garamond (H2 and accent span both '"Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif'), navy #0F2A47 with the single accent span 'operativa' in italic rgb(168,136,73). 'SOBRE MÍ' eyebrow: navy solid, font-weight 600, 13px, letter-spacing 3.64px, uppercase, opacity 1, with a 56x2 gold (rgb(200,164,100)) bar to its left. Zero text-node overlaps detected across About/Services/Process/Contact/Footer on mobile; hero 'Mat. MJyDH N° 5050/2020' badge does not intersect 'Cobertura' or 'Consultas'; all 6 form label/input gaps = 8px (no touching). No horizontal overflow on mobile (scrollWidth 390 = clientWidth). All 27 required data-testids present. E2E form submit succeeded (success state 'Gracias. Recibí su consulta.'), record persisted via GET /api/audience-requests (200, 8 docs). Empty-submit validation blocks with toast 'Por favor complete los campos requeridos...' and 4 :invalid fields. Navbar anchors, hero CTAs, WhatsApp float all functional. No JS/console errors.

minor.issue: email_sent=false with Resend domain-verification error (expected in testing mode per main agent note). No DELETE endpoint exists, so TEST_QA seed record cannot be cleaned up programmatically.

issues: Field is a NATIVE <select> (browser default OS picker), not the shadcn Select component used elsewhere in the design system — visually inconsistent with the rest of the styled inputs.

The native select pre-selects the first option ('Mediación Prejudicial · Accidente de Tránsito') instead of showing a 'Seleccione…' placeholder, so this required field is never actually empty and a user can submit the default without a conscious choice (confirmed: submission with no explicit selection persisted that value).

action_items: Optional polish: replace the native <select> for 'Tipo de trámite' with the shadcn Select and add a non-selectable placeholder option so the required field starts empty.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css .eyebrow correctly sets both `no-underline` and explicit `text-decoration-line: none`, which prevents any future Tailwind utility collision — good fix. Recommend never naming custom component classes after Tailwind utilities (.overline, .underline, .italic, .capitalize).
No DELETE endpoint for /api/audience-requests means QA-created records accumulate in the collection; consider an admin-guarded delete for cleanup.
seed_data_creation: One audience request created via UI: lawyer_name='TEST_QA Estudio', email='qa.test@example.com'. Not removable (no DELETE endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 visual bugs from iteration 2 are verified fixed on desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 via computed-style assertions. Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (8 tests, all pass) — run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py`. Note: 'Tipo de trámite' is a native <select>, so Playwright must use page.select_option() (no [role=option] elements exist). Only remaining item is the cosmetic native-select vs shadcn Select inconsistency.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent): the custom class name `.overline` collided with Tailwind's native `.overline` utility which emits `text-decoration-line: overline`, rendering a line above every eyebrow label. Renaming to `.eyebrow` plus an explicit `text-decoration-line: none` resolved it; verified by auditing computed styles of all 25 .eyebrow nodes and by scanning every element on the page for overline/line-through (0 matches).
